newsitem.title: UK: UK govt to be tough on public sector pay - minister.
newsitem.headline: UK govt to be tough on public sector pay - minister.

text.p: Britain's public sector workers face a tough pay round in the light of the new Labour government's determination to control spending, a senior cabinet minister said on Friday.
"We will have to have very tough negotiations...there isn't the money sculling around," Health Secretary Frank Dobson told BBC radio.
Dobson did not directly answer a question on whether pay increases would be held to the rate of inflation, but said Labour had been making clear for years it would have to keep the lid on pay rises.
He said he recognised that health service workers would be concerned about pay levels.
But he hoped they "will be satisfied, at least to some extent, in the knowledge that the health service is going to be run in the way it used to be -- offering the best care for everybody".
